nameOrigin: creature with pincers and a stinger in its tail

pokedexEntries.dp: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

pokedexEntries.pt: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

pokedexEntries.bw: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.

pokedexEntries.x: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

pokedexEntries.or: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

pokedexEntries.y: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

pokedexEntries.as: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, Gliscor swoops!

pokedexEntries.la: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

pokedexEntries.sc: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

pokedexEntries.vi: It flies soundlessly through the sky. It catches prey with its long tail, then lunges at the prey's vulnerable spots with its fangs.
